effects: Records _submitAddress as the pending submit address of the signer's voter entity, overwriting any earlier pending proposal.
Nothing changes until _submitAddress confirms; at that point it replaces the voter's current submit address.
No tokens or native value move.
formats.shown: Propose submit address, with the proposed address named.

findings.title: proposeSubmitAddress intent does not say the address replaces the current one once it confirms.
findings.evidence: EntityManager.sol proposeSubmitAddress: submitAddressRegistrationQueue[msg.sender] = _submitAddress; confirmSubmitAddressRegistration then unsets the old submit address. Descriptor intent: "Propose submit address".
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to "Propose new submit address for your voter".

effects: The signer's address becomes the submit address of _voter.
The voter's previous submit address, if any, loses its registration.
The voter's pending proposal is deleted.
No tokens or native value move.
formats.shown: Confirm as submit address for voter, with the voter address named.

findings.title: confirmSubmitAddressRegistration does not show that the voter's old submit address is unregistered.
findings.evidence: EntityManager.sol confirmSubmitAddressRegistration: if (oldSubmitAddress != address(0)) submitAddressRegistered[oldSubmitAddress].setAddress(address(0)); the old address is in storage, not in calldata.

effects: Adds _nodeId to the node IDs of the signer's entity, up to maxNodeIdsPerEntity.

Calls the node possession verifier with the signer's certificate and signature. No tokens or native value move.
formats.shown: Register node ID, with the node ID shown as raw bytes; the certificate and signature are hidden.

findings.title: registerNodeId hides the certificate and signature, which only prove possession of the node.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: Certificate and Signature fields have visible "never"; EntityManager.sol registerNodeId passes them only to nodePossessionVerifier.verifyNodePossession.
